rubricDispositions.rationale: The submitted fixture and synthetic passing run cover the declared 2-agency canary setup, 25 primary clients, 100 channels, 100k revisions, 20 events/sec for 60 seconds, 10 concurrent Ask/MCP requests, drain deadline, tenant-denial canaries, and above-envelope admission outcome required by the task packet.

The capacity harness exposes typed run, window, and receipt contracts with explicit metric fields and a shared evaluator imported by the Convex proof test; this task adds an eval harness rather than a public Confect API with typed expected errors.
No durable Convex schema is introduced; the receipt schema pins fixture/config/code hashes, runner, seed, hardware, metrics, failures, and pass/fail as required for this synthetic capacity proof.
The work matches the template-gap plan slice and the pre-review lane gate report records the declared focused commands for evals, Convex, coverage, typecheck, lint, and formatting against this head.

Changed files are within the S13-T02 manifest file locks, the taskBlockHash matches the manifest, and the source-slice report remains within the configured source slice budget and limit despite estimate drift.

The evaluator now validates channel identities per fairness window, exact provider-rate blocks, duplicate/unknown channel anomalies, consecutive-window misses, loss/overflow/leak, tenant-denial canaries, and above-envelope acceptance/queue visibility; tests exercise the declared failure-first cases including aggregate-looking unfair progress and consecutive misses.
